deadline.value: January 1 recommended deadline for Fall admission (late applications reviewed on an ongoing basis).
deadline.quote: January 1 for both full-time M.S. and Ph.D. applications for Fall admission. Late applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until all openings are filled.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required by the College of Engineering.
gre_general.quote: The GRE subject test is no longer required by our school—neither the General Test nor any Subject Test.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Chemical Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students are paired with a faculty advisor upon acceptance based on research interests.
supervisor.quote: Upon acceptance, students are paired with a faculty advisor based on their research interests, and meetings with advisors typically occur on a regular basis to ensure continuous progress.

funding.value: Full-time Ph.D. students generally receive financial aid (assistantships or fellowships) throughout their tenure of study.
funding.quote: Full-time Ph.D. graduate students generally receive financial aid throughout their tenure of study.

entry_route.value: Must hold a B.A./B.S. degree from an accredited college or university.
entry_route.quote: Must hold a B.A./B.S. degree from an accredited college or university.
